title_en: Great Poems and Songs (6/20): Bai Juyi and the Pipa Player
note_en: 一边……一边…… describes two actions done at the same time by the same person: 她一边弹琵琶，一边讲述自己……的一生 "she played the pipa while telling the story of her life." English uses "while" or an -ing phrase once, but Chinese repeats 一边 before each verb. Episode 5 used the same pattern: 苏轼一边喝酒，一边抬头看着……月亮.

sentences.en: The poem also has the line "The thick strings clatter like a sudden downpour; the thin strings murmur like whispered secrets," comparing the sound of the pipa's thick and thin strings to pouring rain and whispering. Similes built on sound like this are very hard to translate without losing their original sound effects.
